title: Wi-Fi
headline: Wi-Fi
description: Connect your phone and PC to the same Wi-Fi network. PhoneCam Link discovers the camera so you can place it where the shot works best.
note: Automatic LAN discovery is included. A manual phone address is available if your network blocks discovery.

title: USB · ADB
headline: USB ADB
description: Connect a USB data cable and bring the camera feed to your PC. ADB port forwarding is handled by the Windows app.
note: This mode requires Android Developer options, USB debugging and your approval of the PC. Connecting a cable alone does not start the current app.

title: Wi-Fi Direct
headline: Wi-Fi Direct
description: Create a direct Wi-Fi group on your PC and scan its QR code with your phone. A phone-hosted group is also available for compatible adapters.
steps: Create a group on the PC
note: Requires compatible Wi-Fi hardware. Internet availability depends on your network setup; see release notes for adapter requirements.
